web|url=https://emea.gr/epicheiriseis/684198/stoiximan-kentrikos-chorigos-tis-super-league-gia-epomena-25-chronia|title=Stoiximan: Κεντρικός χορηγός της Super League για επόμενα 2,5 χρόνια|date=16 December 2022|lang=el}} was the 90th season of the [[Super League Greece]], the professional association football league in [[Greece]] and the highest level of the Greek football league system under the supervision of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]] established in 1927. The season also marked the 67th championship since the establishment of the 1st National Division in 1959. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] were the defending champions having won their 48th title last season. [[Puma (brand)|Puma]] was the official match ball supplier for a second consecutive year.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/aute-einai-e-episeme-mpala-tou-protathlematos-stoiximan-super-league-2025-26/|title=Αυτή είναι η επίσημη μπάλα του Πρωταθλήματος Stoiximan Super League 2025-26!|date=9 July 2025|lang=el}} The 2025–26 season began on 23 August 2025.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/apophaseis-d-s-21-1-2025/|title=Αποφάσεις Δ.Σ., 21/1/2025|date=21 January 2025|lang=el}} The winter break began on 22 December 2025, while the regular season concluded on 22 March 2026. The Championship and [[UEFA Conference League]] spot play-offs as well as the Relegation play-outs began on 4 April 2026.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/apophaseis-d-s-27-5-2025/|title=Αποφάσεις Δ.Σ. 27/5/2025|date=27 May 2025|lang=el}} The league concluded with the last match day of the Relegation Play-Outs on 21 May 2026. Thiat was the first full season where [[semi-automated offside technology]] was in use, following its introduction during the previous season in the Championship play-offs round. Super League clubs unanimously agreed to its use for the next 4 championships, starting from this season.{{cite web|url=https://monobala.gr/var-kai-imiaftomato-ofsaint-gia-ta-epomena-tessera-chronia-se-kypello-protathlima-kai-super-cup/|title=VAR και ημιαυτόματο οφσάιντ για τα επόμενα τέσσερα χρόνια σε Κύπελλο, πρωτάθλημα και Super Cup|date=14 April 2025|lang=el}} The draw for the fixtures took place on Wednesday 9 July 2025 in [[Alimos]] and the full regular season schedule was released shortly after.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/live-e-klerose-tou-protathlematos-stoiximan-super-league-2025-2026/|title=H Κλήρωση του Πρωταθλήματος Stoiximan Super League 2025-2026|date=9 July 2025|lang=el}} [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] secured the 14th title in their history on 10 May 2026, after defeating [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] by 2–1, at home in the fourth matchday of the Championship play-offs, thus sealing their first title after the [[2022–23 Super League Greece|2022–23]] season.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/e-aek-stephtheke-protathletria-gia-14e-phora/|title=Η ΑΕΚ στέφθηκε πρωταθλήτρια για 14η φορά|date=11 May 2026|lang=el}} ==Teams== Fourteen teams competed in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season and two teams promoted from [[2024-25 Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]]. [[Athlitiki Enosi Larissa F.C.|AEL]] returned in the [[Super League Greece|Super League]], having secured promotion from Super League 2, after a four-year absence and the [[2020–21 Super League Greece|2020–21]] season.{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/kampaniakos-ael-1-2-diplo-anodou-gia-tous-vissini-epistrefontas-sta-megala-salonia-meta-apo-tessera-xronia/|title=Καμπανιακός – ΑΕΛ 1-2: Διπλό ανόδου για τους βυσσινί, επιστρέφοντας στα μεγάλα σαλόνια μετά από τέσσερα χρόνια|date=6 April 2025|lang=el}} [[A.E.
